title: A little breathing room
transcript:
Customer: I lost my job and cannot pay the full balance today.
Agent: I'm sorry you're facing that. We can ask our support team to review a payment plan.
Customer: Will that stop late fees?
Agent: I cannot promise that. The team will explain the terms before you agree.
Customer: Please arrange the review.

key_points: Payment-plan review requested; terms and fee treatment remain undecided.
expected.resolution_details: Payment-plan review requested; terms and fee treatment remain undecided.
action_items: Support team to review payment-plan eligibility and explain terms.
